description: This file contains a JUnit test class for testing the MapContext class, particularly focusing on the preservation of insertion order in a nested property context simulation. It defines an inner class PNode for creating a tree of nodes with properties and includes, and a test method that verifies LinkedHashMap's order preservation within MapContext.
